## [Half-density Hellinger bridge for the theta-half Kubo-Mori shell (R-378)] - 2026-08-28

R-378 adds a finite half-density Hellinger bridge to the theta-half Kubo--Mori shell. For rho=diag(p_i), R=rho^(1/2), and centered Hermitian X, the shell is bounded by (2/beta)||[R,X]||_2||{R,X}||_2 and hence by beta^(-1)(||[R,X]||_2^2+||{R,X}||_2^2)= (4/beta)Tr(rho X^2). Primary and independent lanes cover 2816 all-prefix actual-Q3 contexts; Lean R378 checks the scalar factorization and arithmetic envelope. The half-density bridge is finite and claim-nonbearing; source/volume/cutoff-uniform modular tails, common core, common alpha, KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
